narration:0:1810364001:1.text: An empty goblet floats over to you.
narration:0:1810364001:1.male: An empty goblet floats over to you.
narration:0:1810364001:1.female: An empty goblet floats over to you.

narration:1:1810364002:1.text: You steel yourself and cut your palm.
narration:1:1810364002:1.male: You steel yourself and cut your palm.
narration:1:1810364002:1.female: You steel yourself and cut your palm.

narration:2:1810364003:1.text: You expect blood to drip from your wound, but Graveborn do not bleed. Instead, it drifts into the goblet in an unfathomable manner.
